title: VC-OPD: Visual Counterfactual On-Policy Distillation for Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.14939v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GRPO-style reinforcement learning has advanced vision-language reasoning, but its sequence-level rewards provide limited credit assignment for individual reasoning tokens. On-policy distillation (OPD) addresses this issue by providing dense supervision on student-generated trajectories, yet standard OPD assigns similar importance to all teacher-preferred tokens, including template phrases and visually irrelevant continuations. We introduce Visual Counterfactual On-Policy Distillation (VC-OPD), a grounding-aware distillation method that prioritizes tokens whose correctness depends on image-specific evidence. After a teacher-supervised warm start that stabilizes response formats and reduces noisy rollouts, VC-OPD performs on-policy distillation with two teacher evaluations for each student trajectory: one under the original image and one under a counterfactual image with corrupted instance-specific evidence. translated_title: VC-OPD：用于接地视觉-语言推理的视觉反事实在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: GRPO风格的强化学习推动了视觉-语言推理的发展，但其序列级奖励对单个推理token的信用分配能力有限。在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过在学生生成的轨迹上提供密集监督来解决这个问题，然而标准OPD对所有教师偏好的token赋予相似的重要性，包括模板短语和与视觉无关的延续内容。我们提出了视觉反事实在线策略蒸馏（VC-OPD），这是一种接地感知的蒸馏方法，优先关注那些正确性依赖于图像特定证据的token。在通过教师监督的热启动阶段稳定响应格式并减少噪声采样之后，VC-OPD对每条学生轨迹进行两次教师评估的在线策略蒸馏：一次基于原始图像，另一次基于破坏了实例特定证据的反事实图像。原始图像下的教师蒸馏……
tldr: VC-OPD通过对每条学生轨迹分别在原始图像和破坏了视觉证据的反事实图像下进行两次教师评估，识别并优先蒸馏那些正确性真正依赖于图像特定证据的token，从而实现更接地、更可靠的视觉-语言推理。
en_tdlr: VC-OPD performs two teacher evaluations for each student trajectory—one under the original image and one under a counterfactual image with corrupted instance-specific evidence—to identify and prioritize tokens whose correctness depends on image-specific evidence, enabling more grounded vision-language reasoning.
